items.readme: Hallmark A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.** usehallmark.com  ·  fifty themes  ·  custom on request  ·  redesign and audit by name Made by Together AI. Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of ever
